name: Vase-Shaped LED Humidifier | Model  JSQ07 | USB Wood Grain Ultrasonic Cold Mist Humidifier | Aromatherapy Air Freshener | 200 ml
description:
Transform your surroundings with this stylish Small Vase-Shaped Essential Humidifier. Featuring an elegant wood grain design, ultrasonic cold mist technology, and colorful LED lighting, it helps create a relaxing and pleasant atmosphere in your home, office, bedroom, or other personal spaces. Its compact USB-powered design makes it easy to use and carry wherever you need a refreshing mist and your favorite aroma.

Key Features
Stylish vase-shaped design with elegant wood grain finish
Ultrasonic cold mist technology for fine and gentle mist
Can be used with water and compatible essential oils for aromatherapy
200ml water capacity for convenient use
Soft ambient lighting helps create a relaxing atmosphere
Low-noise operation designed for quiet environments
Waterless auto-off function for added safety
Automatic water level detection
USB-powered for convenient everyday use
Compact, lightweight, and portable design
Suitable for bedrooms, offices, living rooms, cars, and other small spaces

Product Specifications
Product Type: Ultrasonic Essential Humidifier
Capacity: 200ml
Technology: Ultrasonic Cold Mist
Power Source: USB
Design: Vase Shape with Wood Grain Finish
Noise Level: Low-Noise Operation
Safety Feature: Waterless Auto-Off
Usage: Aromatherapy, Humidification, and Ambient Lighting

How to Use
Open the diffuser and add clean water without exceeding the maximum level
Add a few drops of suitable essential oil if desired
Close the lid securely
Connect the device to a USB power source
Press the power button to start the mist
Adjust the LED light setting as desired
The device automatically switches off when the water runs out

Material / Composition
Wood Grain-Finish Outer Body
Plastic Components
Ultrasonic Mist System
LED Lighting Components
Electronic Water Level Detection Components

Safety Information
Use on a flat and stable surface
Do not overfill the water tank
Keep the USB connection away from water
Use suitable essential oils according to product instructions
Clean the device regularly to maintain proper performance
Keep out of reach of children when in operation
Disconnect the power supply before cleaning
Store in a cool, dry place when not in use

Package Includes
